check.canonical:
tempo 132
key d:dorian
let riff = d2! ~ d2 f2^ ~ a2 ~ c3
let stab = x ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x
deck A: kick x ~ x ~ | snare ~ x ~ x | hihat humanize([x*8], 3, 12) vel=40..90
deck A: bass every(4, rotate(riff, 2), [<riff reverse(riff)>]) inst=sub-bass
deck B: melody transpose([<riff octave(riff, 1)>], 7) oct=4 | arp degrade(slow([a4 c5 e5 g5], 2), 0.25, 7) inst=pluck
deck B: harmony fast(stab, 2) inst=warm-pad
